passport.author: Arena
passport.purpose: Human preference for generated web applications. Does not measure percent of tasks solved.
passport.requirements: Published WebDev Overall scenario; browser/tool harness version and budgets not disclosed.
passport.scoring: Published Arena Score (Bradley-Terry preference rating), higher is better; not percent accuracy. Published score intervals and rank spreads are retained. Confidence level and fitting settings of this snapshot are unknown. Medals reflect point-estimate order, not a significant difference.

reviews.explanation: Arena publishes human preference measurements; provider relationships and commercial evaluations are disclosed, full financial independence of this snapshot was not established.
Training-data overlap and vote manipulation of this exact snapshot have not been audited. Absence of evidence is not proof of absence.
Preference points have no percentage ceiling. Rank spreads overlap, especially in Text Coding. No saturation audit was performed.
Arena-Rank source is public, but complete votes, model snapshots, harness and fitting settings for these dated category tables were not reproduced.

Compare within this source scenario and date only. Effort labels are literal source strings; their semantics and equal budgets are unknown. Separate scenarios may have overlapping people and requests.
